algae-soup.text: A thin green soup made from pond weed.

baked-potato.text: A potato baked until soft, a simple meal.

basic-fertilizer.text: Spread on tilled soil before planting.

basic-retaining-soil.text: Spread on tilled soil before planting.

bat-wing.text: Dropped by the bats of the mines.

bee-house.text: A hive that makes honey over time.

big-chest.text: A roomy chest for storing goods.

big-stone-chest.text: A larger chest made of stone.

cheese-melt.text: Melted cheese, hot from the pan.

cheese.text: Made from milk in a cheese press.

copper-bar.text: Smelted from copper ore in a furnace.

copper-ore.text: Dug from rock in the mines and quarry.

crab.text: A shellfish from a shellfish pot.

crayfish.text: A shellfish from a shellfish pot.

crystalarium.text: A machine that copies a crystal again and again.

dye-vat.text: Where cloth and goods are dyed.

egg.text: Laid by the hens in the coop.

fried-egg.text: An egg fried in the pan, simple and quick.

fiber.text: Pulled from weeds and long grass.

gold-bar.text: Smelted from gold ore in a furnace.

hardwood.text: Dense wood from a tree that needs a good axe.

honey.text: Made by bees in a bee house.

iron-bar.text: Smelted from iron ore in a furnace.

iron-ore.text: Dug from rock in the mines and quarry.

loom.text: Weaves wool and fiber into cloth.

mayonnaise.text: Made from an egg in a mayonnaise machine.

oil-maker.text: Presses oil from crops and seeds.

preserves-jar.text: Turns fruit and vegetables into jam and pickles.

seed-maker.text: Turns a crop back into seeds.

shellfish-pot.text: Left in the water to catch shellfish.

sprinkler.text: Waters the crops next to it each morning.

quality-sprinkler.text: Waters more of the crops around it each morning.

tapper.text: Set on a tree to gather what it gives.

heavy-tapper.text: A tapper that works twice as fast.

tea-sapling.text: Plant it to grow a tea bush.

green-tea.text: A drink made from tea leaves.

iron-lamp-post.text: A lamp post of iron to light the paths.

wood-lamp-post.text: A lamp post of wood to light the paths.

stone-brazier.text: A brazier of stone that gives light.

wood-brazier.text: A brazier of wood that gives light.

lightning-rod.text: Draws lightning away from the farm in a storm.

glow-ring.text: A ring that gives off light.

small-glow-ring.text: A ring that gives off a little light.

magnet-ring.text: A ring that draws things towards you.

pressed-flower.text: A flower dried flat between pages.

faded-ribbon.text: A ribbon with its colour worn away.

glint-lure.text: A lure that flashes in the water.

bug-meat.text: A cheap drop from the mines. Sells for 8 coins.

carved-bead.text: A small keepsake found while digging. Sells for 55 coins.

cherry.text: A tree fruit that sells for 80 coins and restores 38 energy.

coop-heater.text: Bought for 2000 coins and kept, not sold.

elf-letter.text: A keepsake. It cannot be sold.

fisher-stew.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 220 coins and restores 150 energy.

garden-salad.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 110 coins and restores 110 energy.

gem-high-a.text: A high tier gem that sells for 400 coins. Placeholder name.

gem-high-b.text: The finest gem. Sells for 750 coins.

gem-low-a.text: A low tier gem that sells for 50 coins. Placeholder name.

gem-low-b.text: A low tier gem that sells for 75 coins. Placeholder name.

gem-mid-a.text: A middle tier gem that sells for 150 coins. Placeholder name.

gem-mid-b.text: A middle tier gem that sells for 250 coins. Placeholder name.

gloop-jelly.text: A drop from slimes. Sells for 12 coins.

green-glass-lantern.text: A keepsake lantern. It cannot be sold.

harvest-hotpot.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 240 coins and restores 170 energy.

hearthsilver-bar.text: Smelted from hearthsilver ore. Sells for 1000 coins.

hearty-omelette.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 100 coins and restores 125 energy.

honey-cake.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 160 coins and restores 120 energy.

inn-custard.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 130 coins and restores 120 energy.

innkeepers-roast.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 260 coins and restores 180 energy.

ladle-snail.text: A shellfish caught in traps. Sells for 70 coins.

market-pie.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 160 coins and restores 140 energy.

marsh-clam.text: A shellfish caught in traps. Sells for 90 coins.

mayo-slaw.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 260 coins and restores 140 energy.

mixed-seed.text: Seeds of no certain kind. Sells for 5 coins.

mushroom-stew.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 190 coins and restores 150 energy.

oil-lamp.text: A standing lamp for the house. It cannot be sold.

old-seed-packet.text: A faded packet found while digging. Sells for 40 coins.

pearl-lobster.text: A prized shellfish caught in traps. Sells for 800 coins.

pumpkin-soup.text: A cooked dish. Sells for 400 coins and restores 200 energy.

reef-periwinkle.text: A shellfish caught in traps. Sells for 50 coins.

river-mussel.text: A shellfish caught in traps. Sells for 45 coins.

spiny-shrimp.text: A shellfish caught in traps. Sells for 100 coins.

stone-chest.text: A chest for storing things. It cannot be sold.

warp-totem-beach.text: A totem that carries you to the beach. It cannot be sold.

wax.text: Beeswax from the apiary. Sells for 40 coins.

blue-ribbon-melon.text: The prize for first place at the Harvest Showing, given once a year. Every villager loves it as a gift.

glimmerstone.text: A rare gem found deep in the mines, from floor 100 down. It sells for 1,000 coins.

frost-berry.text: A cold blue berry dropped by Frostnibblers in the icy parts of the mines.

ice-shard.text: A sliver of clear ice dropped by Icicle Hoppers. It never quite melts.

driftwood.text: A weathered stick, sometimes pulled up in a crab or lobster pot. It is worth almost nothing, and the villagers do not care for it as a gift.

beer.text: Brewed in a keg. Any beer sells for 200 coins.

peach.text: A soft summer fruit from the peach tree, which takes a sapling bought for 6,000 coins. It sells for 140 coins.

truffle-oil.text: A rich oil pressed from a truffle. Some villagers love it as a gift, and it sells for 1,250 coins.

goat-cheese.text: Cheese pressed from goat milk, worth more than cheese from cow milk. It sells for 540 coins.

grape-wine.text: Wine made from wild grapes, left to turn in a keg. It sells for 240 coins.

mead.text: A sweet drink made from honey. It sells for 300 coins.

moonwool.text: A pale, silvery tuft that a sheep may leave beside its wool once it trusts you well enough. The tailor can make night trousers from it.

pomegranate.text: A tart fall fruit from the pomegranate tree, which takes a sapling bought for 6,000 coins. It sells for 140 coins.

pocket-coin.text: A small coin dropped by Nabblers. Fitch and Wren both love to be given one. It sells for 15 coins.
